name: criterion-4
text: Criterion 4 (O-1A 4, EB-1A iv): participation as a judge of the work of others in the same or an allied field.

Counts (C4-service-proof): an invitation plus proof of service: a calendar event that occurred, the judging page listing the founder, a thank-you after the event, or a judging certificate. Judging any hackathon counts, student hackathons included (D-student-hackathon-judging). Judging for recognized award programs counts. Code reviews on popular open-source repos (at least 1,000 stars, not the founder own repo) count as comparable evidence (D-code-review-comparable).

Building: an invitation never answered (C4-invite-unanswered); an accepted invitation whose event has not happened (C4-awaiting-service); an event that was cancelled (C4-event-cancelled); a review on a repo below the threshold (C4-review-below-threshold).
Rejected: an invitation declined (T-invite-declined); attending as a participant or mentor without evaluating anyone (T-mentor-not-judge).
Signals: Gmail invites, certificates and thank-yous; Calendar events; event pages; GitHub reviews on other people repos.
